# Introduction

This first script imports, clean and prepares raw association data collected from *Myotis bechsteinii* in two colonies (GB2 and UA), near Wurzburg in Germany between 2013 and 2023.

### Data description

-   **Raw roost datasets**: one data set for each year, each row representing a day of observation, column names represent the individuals in the colony. Number in the table represent the roost number where the individual spent the day.

-   **Mother-daughter file**: One for each colony, each row is a mother-daughter pair. Column name "rfid_mom" (mother ID), "rfid_off" (daughter ID), year and a unique pairID composed of the rfid_mom and rfid_off, order alphabetically to ensure universal ID.

```{r}
#| label: packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#code-fold: true
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(igraph)
library(asnipe)
library(sna)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(igraph)
library(data.table)
```

Load mother-daughter lists
```{r}
mother_daughter_GB2 <- read.csv(here("data","mother_daughter_GB2.csv"))
mother_daughter_UA <- read.csv(here("data","mother_daughter_UA.csv"))
```

Load colony size dataset
```{r load-colony-size}
colony_size_GB2 <- read.csv(
  here("data", "saved_matrices", "GB2", "colony_size_df.csv"),
  header = TRUE, sep = ","
) %>% mutate(year = as.numeric(year))

colony_size_UA <- read.csv(
  here("data", "saved_matrices", "UA", "colony_size_UA.csv"),
  header = TRUE, sep = ","
) %>% mutate(year = as.numeric(year))
```

### 1.2 GBI and edge lists

The **Group-by-Individual matrix** (GBI), is the format required for most function in the <igraph> and <asnipe> packages. We can create the GBI matrix from raw roost data by merging day and box number together, creating unique "group" of individuals that roosted all together in the same day in the same roost. This transforms the dataset into a presence/absence matrix. The column names remain the individual ID.  

We can also create the **association matrices** that calculates the pairwise association using the SRI (simple ratio index)

```{r}
#Create a function that will create the GBI, the association matrices, the network objects and the edge list for all years 
create_matrices <- function(data, year, colony, mother_daughter_df) {
  
  #--- Create GBI matrix
  data_long <- data %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(date),
      names_to = "ID",
      values_to = "box"
    ) %>%
    drop_na(box)
  
  data_long$daygroup <- as.factor(paste(data_long$date, data_long$box, sep = "_"))
  
  ind <- data.table(
    ID = data_long$ID,
    group = data_long$daygroup,
    day = data_long$date
  )
  
  # use the function in the asnipe package
  GBI <- get_group_by_individual(ind, data_format = "individuals")
  GBI <- as.matrix(GBI)
  write.csv(GBI, here("data", "saved_matrices", colony, paste0("GBI_G", year, ".csv")), row.names = TRUE)
  
  # create network
  net <- get_network(GBI, data_format = "GBI", association_index = "SRI")
  write.csv(net, here("data", "saved_matrices", colony, paste0("net_G", year, ".csv")), row.names = TRUE)
  
  # create edge list
  g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(net, mode = "undirected", weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE)
  edge <- igraph::as_data_frame(g, what = "edges")
  
  edge <- edge %>%
    mutate(
      pairID = ifelse(
        from < to,
        paste(from, to, sep = "-"),
        paste(to, from, sep = "-")
      )
    )
  
  # Add pair type, either "mother-daughter" if the pairID is present in the mother_daughter df, otherwise "other"
  edge <- edge %>%
    mutate(
      pair_type = ifelse(
        pairID %in% mother_daughter_df$pairID[mother_daughter_df$year == year], 
        "mother-daughter",
        "other"
      )
    )
  write.csv(edge, here("data", "saved_matrices", colony, paste0("edge_G", year, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  
  return(edge)
}
```

Run the function
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| output: false
#| 
years <- 2013:2023

for (y in 2013:2023) {
  create_matrices(
    data = get(paste0("GB2_", y)),
    year = y,
    colony = "GB2",
    mother_daughter_df = mother_daughter_GB2
  )
}
```

### 1.3 merge all years
```{r}
edges_all <- lapply(2013:2023, function(y) {
  #load the created edge lists for each year
  df <- read.csv(here("data", "saved_matrices", "GB2", paste0("edge_G", y, ".csv")))
  # add the year in a new column
  df$year <- y
  return(df)
})

edges_GB2 <- bind_rows(edges_all)
#and save it 
write.csv(edges_GB2, here("data","saved_matrices","GB2","edge_list_GB2.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

### 2.2 GBI, edge lists 
```{r}
#Create a function that will create the GBI, the association matrices (net), the network objects and the edge list for all years 
create_matrices_UA <- function(data, year, colony, mother_daughter_df) {
  
  # Create GBI matrix
  data_long <- data %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(date),
      names_to = "ID",
      values_to = "box"
    ) %>%
    drop_na(box)
  
  data_long$daygroup <- as.factor(paste(data_long$date, data_long$box, sep = "_"))
  
  ind <- data.table(
    ID = data_long$ID,
    group = data_long$daygroup,
    day = data_long$date
  )
  
  #then use the function in the 'asnipe' package
  GBI <- get_group_by_individual(ind, data_format = "individuals")
  GBI <- as.matrix(GBI)
  write.csv(GBI, here("data", "saved_matrices", colony, paste0("GBI_U", year, ".csv")), row.names = TRUE)
  
  # Create network
  net <- get_network(GBI, data_format = "GBI", association_index = "SRI")
  write.csv(net, here("data", "saved_matrices", colony, paste0("net_U", year, ".csv")), row.names = TRUE)
  
  # Create edge list
  g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(net, mode = "undirected", weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE)
  edge <- igraph::as_data_frame(g, what = "edges")
  
  edge <- edge %>%
    mutate(
      pairID = ifelse(
        from < to,
        paste(from, to, sep = "-"),
        paste(to, from, sep = "-")
      )
    )
  
  # Add pair type, either "mother-daughter" if the pairID is present in the mother_daughter df, otherwise "other"
  edge <- edge %>%
    mutate(
      pair_type = ifelse(
        pairID %in% mother_daughter_df$pairID[mother_daughter_df$year == year], 
        "mother-daughter",
        "other"
      )
    )
  write.csv(edge, here("data", "saved_matrices", colony, paste0("edge_U", year, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  
  return(edge)
}
```

# 3 - Mother - non-related daughter datasets
Creation of a lists that state associations between mothers and non-related daughters, by creating a function that goes into the mother-daughter df, and assign them in a role for a specific year, either "mother" or "daughter"

```{r}
make_mom_juv_for_year <- function(y, edges, md_table) {
  md_y <- md_table %>% filter(year == y)

  # bats that matter in this year -> mothers and daughters only
  bats_y <- unique(c(md_y$rfid_mom, md_y$rfid_off))

  edges_y <- edges %>%
    filter(year == y) %>%
    filter(from %in% bats_y | to %in% bats_y)

  # lookup table with roles
  lookup_y <- md_y %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(rfid_mom, rfid_off),
      names_to = "role",
      values_to = "batID"
    ) %>%
    distinct(batID, role)

  edges_y <- edges_y %>%
    left_join(lookup_y, by = c("from" = "batID")) %>%
    rename(from_role = role) %>%
    left_join(lookup_y, by = c("to" = "batID")) %>%
    rename(to_role = role)

  # ordered pairID, to ensure correct matching
  make_pairID <- function(x, y) {
    ifelse(x < y, paste(x, y, sep = "-"), paste(y, x, sep = "-"))
  }

  edges_y <- edges_y %>%
    mutate(pairID = make_pairID(from, to))

  # identify true MD pairs for this year
  true_MD_y <- md_y %>%
    mutate(pairID = make_pairID(rfid_mom, rfid_off)) %>%
    select(pairID)

  edges_y <- edges_y %>%
    mutate(
    pair_type_2 = case_when(
      # true mother–daughter
      pairID %in% true_MD_y$pairID ~ "mother-daughter",

      # mother with a non-own juvenile
      ((from_role == "rfid_mom" & to_role == "rfid_off") |
        (from_role == "rfid_off" & to_role == "rfid_mom")
      ) ~ "mother-unrelated-daughter",

      # everything else
      TRUE ~ "other"
    )
  )

}
```

Run function for both colonies
```{r}

#for GB2
mom_juv_GB2 <- map_dfr(
  years,
  make_mom_juv_for_year,
```

# 4 - Daughter-daughter associations 
-> Create the daughters pairs table
```{r}
juv_pairs_GB2 <- mother_daughter_GB2 %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  # get all combinations of juveniles within the same year
  summarise(
    pairs = list(as.data.frame(t(combn(rfid_off, 2)))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest(pairs) %>%
  rename(juv1 = V1, juv2 = V2) %>%
  # create sorted pairID
  mutate(pairID = if_else(juv1 < juv2,
                          paste(juv1, juv2, sep = "-"),
                          paste(juv2, juv1, sep = "-")))

juv_pairs_GB2

write.csv(juv_pairs_GB2,here("data","juv_pairs_GB2.csv"))

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest(pairs) %>%
  rename(juv1 = V1, juv2 = V2) %>%
  # create sorted pairID
  mutate(pairID = if_else(juv1 < juv2,
                          paste(juv1, juv2, sep = "-"),
                          paste(juv2, juv1, sep = "-")))

juv_pairs_UA
```

# 5- create final edge list
```{r}
# Prepare 4 pair type edge list ----- 
build_four_type_edges <- function(edges, mom_juv, juv_pairs, colony_size) {
  edges %>%
    left_join(colony_size, by = "year") %>%
    
    # join mother-unrelated juveniles labels — with year, so only labelled in the year the juvenile was marked
    left_join(
      mom_juv %>% select(pairID, year, pair_type_2),
      by = c("pairID", "year")
    ) %>%
    
    # join juv-juv labels — with year, so only labelled in the year both were juveniles
    left_join(
      juv_pairs %>% select(pairID, year) %>% mutate(is_juv_juv = TRUE),
      by = c("pairID", "year")
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      # priority order: MD > M-NRD > juv-juv > other
      pair_type_2 = case_when(
        pair_type_2 == "mother-daughter"           ~ "mother-daughter",
        pair_type_2 == "mother-unrelated-daughter" ~ "mother-unrelated-juvenile",
        is_juv_juv == TRUE                         ~ "daughter-daughter",
        TRUE                                       ~ "other"
      ),
      pair_type_2 = factor(pair_type_2,
                           levels = c("other",
                                      "daughter-daughter",
                                      "mother-unrelated-juvenile",
                                      "mother-daughter")),
      colony_size_c = as.numeric(scale(colony_size, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))
    ) %>%
    select(-is_juv_juv)
}
```
## 3.2 edge lists - add pair types

```{r}
edge_GB2 <- build_four_type_edges(edges_GB2, mom_juv_GB2, juv_pairs_GB2, colony_size_GB2)
edge_UA  <- build_four_type_edges(edges_UA,  mom_juv_UA, juv_pairs_UA, colony_size_UA)
```


# measure observation number
to check sample bias sampling bias
```{r}
#put all roosting matrix in list
roost_list_GB2 <- mget(ls(pattern = "*GB2_20*", envir = .GlobalEnv), envir = .GlobalEnv)
names(roost_list_GB2) <- gsub("GB2_", "", names(roost_list_GB2))

roost_list_UA <- mget(ls(pattern = "*UA_20*", envir = .GlobalEnv), envir = .GlobalEnv)
names(roost_list_UA) <- gsub("UA_", "", names(roost_list_UA))
```

```{r}
#function
compute_n_obs <- function(edge_df, roost_list) {
  edge_df %>%
    mutate(year_chr = as.character(year)) %>%
    group_split(year_chr) %>%
    map_dfr(function(sub_edges) {
      yr <- unique(sub_edges$year_chr)
      roost_df <- roost_list[[yr]]

      if (is.null(roost_df)) {
        sub_edges$n_obs <- NA_integer_
        return(sub_edges)
      }

      sub_edges$n_obs <- map_int(sub_edges$pairID, function(pid) {
        ids <- strsplit(pid, "-", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
        if (length(ids) != 2) return(NA_integer_)
        id1 <- ids[1]; id2 <- ids[2]

        if (!(id1 %in% names(roost_df)) || !(id2 %in% names(roost_df))) {
          return(NA_integer_)
        }
        sum(!is.na(roost_df[[id1]]) | !is.na(roost_df[[id2]]))
      })
      sub_edges
    }) %>%
    select(-year_chr)
}
```

```{r}
edge_GB2 <- compute_n_obs(edge_GB2, roost_list_GB2)
edge_UA  <- compute_n_obs(edge_UA,  roost_list_UA)
```
